subject: bookshelf
name: 书架
label: 两层小书架
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One low two-shelf bookcase front view with three large books on each shelf.
Strictly keep the stated number of objects; large spaced clear shapes. Book spines if present are plain empty rectangles, no lettering or tiny bands. No decorative carving, texture, woodgrain, shadows or gray wash. Realistic connected furniture structure. Whole object with generous surrounding margin.
